title: Symmons 3DIVBODYSRT Temptrol Brass Triple Outlet Diverter Valve

comparisons.notes: Same Symmons 3DIVBODYSRT triple outlet diverter body, in stock

writeup: Symmons' 3DIVBODYSRT is the brass Temptrol triple-outlet diverter valve body, made in the USA, that routes water to three outlets such as a showerhead, body sprays and a hand shower. It works with 16 and 26 Series Temptrol valves and has 1/2-inch IPS and sweat connections. Plumbing supply stores sell it for $155 to $168.
